subject: general
question: Indian athlete Somdev Devvarman is associated with, which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawn Tennis.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian athlete **Somdev Devvarman** is associated with **Lawn Tennis.**
 
• Being the only collegiate player to have advanced to **three consecutive NCAA finals**—having won back-to-back championships at the **University of Virginia** in his junior and senior years—he garnered headlines.
 
• Since **1950**, only** three other players** have been able to match that record.
 
• The Indian government awarded Devvarman the **Arjuna Award in 2011** in recognition of his achievements in tennis.
 
• The Indian government's **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** designated him as a **national tennis observer** in **March 2017.**
 
• He received the civilian **Padma Shri award in 2018.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis** is a sport where** two or four players** hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using **small rackets.**

 
 
• On a **hard table** split by a net, the game is played.
 
 
 
• **Hockey** is a sport in which **two teams **play against each other by trying to maneuver a ball or a puck into the opponent's goal using a **hockey stick. **
 
 
• Influences from both European and indigenous cultures gave rise to the modern sport in **Canada. **
 
 
 
• **Football** is a team sport where two teams of **eleven players** each, try to score goals by getting the ball into the opposing team's **goalpost.**
 
 
• The following nations—**France, Haiti, Israel, Italy, Poland, Mauritius, and Mongolia**—have football as their national sport.
